profile.headline: Software Engineer at Undisclosed
profile.summary: I have a multi-disciplinary background with both analytical and technical expertise. I learn very quickly and am able to adapt to any environment. My interests lie in finding solutions and pathways to complex workflow problems and more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created and led a Python-based client metric reporting solution starting as a POC and has been in production now for three+ years.
•	Helped spearhead the development of a backend API for reporting solution that can handle client, platform, and product level reporting, metrics, and notifications. This is a hybrid cloud architecture built on top of AWS, internal cloud, Java as the core backend, Python for AWS Lambdas, NoSQL based storage, etc. 
•	Spearheaded a python SDK to facilitate connections for developers for API in use throughout the organization
•	Designed and developed frontend for the backend API mentioned above. Built on top of existing frontend infrastructure, extended the frontend to include a client facing web app for the API. Tooling was built using React.JS, NPM, TypeScript, and an internally developed design paradigm built on top of React.JS components. 
•	Led several data analysis deep dives to investigate bottlenecks, latency optimization, transactions consolidations, creating automated self-adjusting anomaly detection and threshold adjustments. This work is often done through Python, Pandas, and any relevant tooling required to obtain data. These reports often form the basis for teams to fix and optimize their applications.
•	Data engineering tasks performing ETL with multiple data sources including Databricks, different flavours of databases, proprietary applications, work in Pandas to create models and then port to relevant final destination
•	Advocated for promoting accessibility features and design considerations.
